messages:
Jordan H: hi all — Jordan here, first day on Growth design. quick access Q: I signed in via SSO but I see 'pending invite' for the Redwood Inference Figma org. who should I bug for access? :wave:
Aisha Malik: welcome! :tada: Lina owns Figma provisioning. usually Okta mapping puts you into 'redwood-designers'. @Lina can you check?
Lina O: hey Jordan — can you confirm the email you used (work or personal)? I can resend the invite once I know.
Jordan H: used jordan.h@redwood.com (work).
DesignOps Bot: Lina O added Jordan H to Okta group 'redwood-designers' at 2026-03-23T15:02:37Z.
Lina O: invite resent. if you don't see the mail, try signing into figma then open the org link: https://www.figma.com/@redwood-inference
Jordan H: got it, accepted the org invite but I still don't see the Growth files or the component library.
Aisha Malik: Growth files are gated under the Growth team with editor access. I will add you to the Growth editors group now. the component library is a separate project called 'Redwood UI Tokens'.
Samir Patel: small note — if you already had a personal Figma account attached to your browser, invites sometimes attach there and show 'pending'. sign out of personal accounts.
Jordan H: that was me earlier haha. switched to the work account, looking better now.
Riley Chen: for research context, Notion holds playbooks + the research roadmap: https://redwood.notion.site/design-research. If you need a quick dump of recent studies I can share a pared-down export.
Jordan H: requested Notion access through onboarding, might still be pending. a quick export would be great.
Riley Chen: sending a sanitized PDF of current studies and the qual+quant backlog.
Aisha Malik: procedural FYI: if you need a small UI experiment, file a PR and tag eng-frontend for code review. ping product for prioritization and me or Samir if there are runtime token changes.
Jordan H: good to know. where are ADRs and decision logs kept?
Aisha Malik: Product -> Ops -> Decisions & ADRs in Notion. I can share the Growth-relevant ones if you don't have access yet.
DesignOps Bot: Aisha Malik invited Jordan H to the recurring 'Design Guild' event on Thu 10am PT at 2026-03-23T15:10:04Z.
Jordan H: thanks everyone! one last hiccup: Okta logged me out twice while syncing — filing in #help if it repeats.
Lina O: noted — we ran a quick Okta sync earlier which can cause duplicate sessions. monitoring.
Riley Chen: welcome aboard — I'll DM to set up a 30-min intro to the research playbook and metrics hooks.
Jordan H: appreciate it all :thumbsup:
